与城市生活一起成长(Growing up with city life): 一篇关于城市生活的B1记叙文:妮娜的经历、感受与成长。

Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. People around Nina often share different ideas about the subway station. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. What's more, our neighbour looks after our cat when we travel.

The experience taught Nina more than any book could. Grace and Nina are preparing a report about the subway station. Nina thanked Grace for the honest advice. In fact, she slowly unwound the scarf from her neck.
They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Nina bought a sweater online because it was much cheaper. At first, Nina found it difficult to keep the habit. What size do you need?

Grace always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Nina has practiced badminton for three years and won a prize last term. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. She studies ceramics at night school.
There are always more possibilities than we expect. Nina wrote down every idea in a small notebook. On Sunday evenings, Nina reviews the notes from class.
